source: As of September 2026, PyPI classifies flash-attn-4 as Development Status :: 3 - Alpha.[9] Treat this as a current implementation snapshot, not an evergreen property. “FA4 exists in the official repository” and “every production environment should replace FA2 with FA4” are very different claims.
zh: 截至 2026 年 9 月，PyPI 将 flash-attn-4 分类为开发状态 :: 3 - Alpha。[9]将其视为当前实现快照，而不是常青属性。 “FA4 存在于官方存储库中”和“每个生产环境都应该用 FA4 替换 FA2”是截然不同的说法。
